entries.title: Isaiah 65:1
segments: ¶"I was sought by [those who] did not ask [for Me]; I was found by [those who] did not seek Me. I said, 'Here I am, here I am,' To a nation [that] was not called by My name.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:2
segments: I have stretched out My hands all day long to a rebellious people, Who walk in a way [that is] not good, According to their own thoughts;

entries.title: Isaiah 65:3
segments: A people who provoke Me to anger continually to My face; Who sacrifice in gardens, And burn incense on altars of brick;

entries.title: Isaiah 65:4
segments: Who sit among the graves, And spend the night in the tombs; Who eat swine's flesh, And the broth of abominable things is [in] their vessels;

entries.title: Isaiah 65:5
segments: Who say, 'Keep to yourself, Do not come near me, For I am holier than you!' These [are] smoke in My nostrils, A fire that burns all the day.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:6
segments: "Behold, [it is] written before Me: I will not keep silence, but will repay-Even repay into their bosom-

entries.title: Isaiah 65:7
segments: Your iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together," Says the LORD, "Who have burned incense on the mountains And blasphemed Me on the hills; Therefore I will measure their former work into their bosom."

entries.title: Isaiah 65:8
segments: ¶Thus says the LORD: "As the new wine is found in the cluster, And [one] says, 'Do not destroy it, For a blessing [is] in it,' So will I do for My servants' sake, That I may not destroy them all.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:9
segments: I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, And from Judah an heir of My mountains; My elect shall inherit it, And My servants shall dwell there.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:10
segments: Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, And the Valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down, For My people who have sought Me.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:11
segments: ¶"But you [are] those who forsake the LORD, Who forget My holy mountain, Who prepare a table for Gad, And who furnish a drink offering for Meni.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:12
segments: Therefore I will number you for the sword, And you shall all bow down to the slaughter; Because, when I called, you did not answer; When I spoke, you did not hear, But did evil before My eyes, And chose [that] in which I do not delight."

entries.title: Isaiah 65:13
segments: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: "Behold, My servants shall eat, But you shall be hungry; Behold, My servants shall drink, But you shall be thirsty; Behold, My servants shall rejoice, But you shall be ashamed;

entries.title: Isaiah 65:14
segments: Behold, My servants shall sing for joy of heart, But you shall cry for sorrow of heart, And wail for grief of spirit.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:15
segments: You shall leave your name as a curse to My chosen; For the Lord GOD will slay you, And call His servants by another name;

entries.title: Isaiah 65:16
segments: So that he who blesses himself in the earth Shall bless himself in the God of truth; And he who swears in the earth Shall swear by the God of truth; Because the former troubles are forgotten, And because they are hidden from My eyes.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:17
segments: ¶"For behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; And the former shall not be remembered or come to mind.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:18
segments: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I create; For behold, I create Jerusalem [as] a rejoicing, And her people a joy.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:19
segments: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, And joy in My people; The voice of weeping shall no longer be heard in her, Nor the voice of crying.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:20
segments: "No more shall an infant from there [live but a few] days, Nor an old man who has not fulfilled his days; For the child shall die one hundred years old, But the sinner [being] one hundred years old shall be accursed.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:21
segments: They shall build houses and inhabit [them]; They shall plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:22
segments: They shall not build and another inhabit; They shall not plant and another eat; For as the days of a tree, [so shall be] the days of My people, And My elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:23
segments: They shall not labor in vain, Nor bring forth children for trouble; For they [shall be] the descendants of the blessed of the LORD, And their offspring with them.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:24
segments: "It shall come to pass That before they call, I will answer; And while they are still speaking, I will hear.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:25
segments: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, The lion shall eat straw like the ox, And dust [shall be] the serpent's food. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all My holy mountain," Says the LORD.
